_meta.note: Ручные английские переводы для TERMS и SOUNDS. Эти два списка автопереводу не подлежат — вызовы translate_field_to_english для них удаляются. Значения ниже перезаписи не подлежат. | 05.09.2026: в каждую запись добавлено поле de (TERMS — term, SOUNDS — combo) для сверки переезда id.
conventions: Немецкие грамматические термины (Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ, Modalverben, W-Fragen) в английском тексте сохраняются по-немецки — так же, как они сохранены в русском.
Немецкие примеры внутри note не переводятся ни при каких условиях.
pronunciationEn — это IPA, а не перевод кириллической транскрипции.

t0002.noteEn: W-Frage: W-Wort + Verb | Ja/Nein: Verb + Subj.

t0003.noteEn: war, hatte — mostly written language, and sein/haben/Modalverben

t0026.noteEn: Wer ist das? — Who is that?

t0027.noteEn: Was machst du? — What are you doing?

t0036.noteEn: the verb goes to the end | weil, dass, wenn...

t0037.noteEn: subordinating conjunction → verb at the end of the Nebensatz

t0038.noteEn: als in a Nebensatz — a single event in the past (Als ich Kind war...) | als in comparison — than (größer als)

t0039.noteEn: ab + Dativ: ab Montag, ab 8 Uhr; also a prefix (abfahren)

t0043.noteEn: for countable nouns, unlike Wie viel? (t0034)

t0051.noteEn: a prefix; used only inside compound words

t0055.noteEn: per + Akkusativ, no article: per Überweisung, per Mail

t0056.noteEn: + Genitiv: wegen des Wetters | colloquially often + Dativ

t0057.noteEn: a connecting adverb - triggers inversion: Trotzdem gehe ich.

t0058.noteEn: a connecting adverb - triggers inversion: Deswegen bleibe ich.

t0059.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction — the verb moves to the end: Man spart Strom, indem man den Stecker zieht. It names the manner, not the cause: replace it with weil and the sentence stops answering "how?"

t0060.noteEn: a listing conjunction, the same sense as und, but written register. It does not change the word order. Not to be confused with so wie – “the same way as”

t0061.noteEn: a condition that is not met – Wenn ich Zeit hätte, würde ich kommen. Both halves stand in Konjunktiv II

t0062.noteEn: A coordinating conjunction in position 0 – it stands outside the clause, so the word order does not change: Ich lerne Deutsch und ich arbeite.

t0063.noteEn: A coordinating conjunction in position 0, it does not change the word order: Nimmst du Tee oder Kaffee?

t0064.noteEn: A coordinating conjunction: it stands outside the clause, so the verb stays in second place – Ich bleibe zu Hause, denn ich bin müde. weil (because) carries the same meaning but sends the verb to the end. English for behaves the same way: I am staying home, for I am tired.

t0065.noteEn: Used only after a negation, and it replaces what was rejected: Das ist kein Tee, sondern Kaffee. Without nicht or kein you need aber (but).

t0066.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb moves to the very end: Ich weiß, dass du morgen kommst.

t0067.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Wenn es regnet, bleibe ich zu Hause. A condition or a repeated action; for a single event in the past you need als.

t0068.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction of purpose – the verb goes to the end: Ich spreche langsam, damit du mich verstehst. When both halves share one subject, um ... zu is the usual choice.

t0069.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Bevor ich gehe, esse ich etwas.

t0070.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction of the indirect question – the verb goes to the end: Ich weiß nicht, ob er kommt. Not to be confused with wenn: ob is whether, wenn is if.

t0071.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end, and the tenses have to differ: Plusquamperfekt in the subordinate clause, Präteritum in the main one – Nachdem er gegessen hatte, ging er los.

t0072.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Falls es regnet, nehme ich den Schirm. The same as wenn, but it stresses that the case is unlikely.

t0073.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Während ich koche, liest er. The same word also works as a preposition with Genitiv – während des Essens.

t0074.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Sobald ich fertig bin, rufe ich dich an.

t0075.noteEn: Subordinating conjunction – the verb goes to the end: Solange es regnet, bleiben wir hier.

t0076.noteEn: haben or sein + Partizip II – the main past form in spoken German

t0077.noteEn: what changes on the article, the adjective and the verb when they decline or conjugate

s0012.comboEn: Ch after a, o, u, au

s0013.de: Ch после e, i, ei, ä, ö, ü
s0013.comboEn: Ch after e, i, ei, ä, ö, ü

s0015.exampleEn: der Vater, die Firma, das Alphabet

s0017.exampleEn: word-initially before a vowel it is [z] (Sonne); word-finally or before a consonant it is [s]
